sub_graphs.title: Bellatrix: PoW to PoS Merge Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition from the last PoW block to the first PoS block, including terminal block validation

nodes.label: Pre-Merge State (PoW Active)
nodes.description: The beacon chain is running but execution payloads are empty; PoW chain is the canonical execution chain

nodes.label: Merge Transition Block Received
nodes.description: A beacon block containing the first non-empty execution payload has been received

nodes.label: Detect Merge Transition Block
nodes.description: Check is_merge_transition_block: pre-state has no execution yet and block body contains a non-empty execution payload

nodes.label: Validate Terminal PoW Block
nodes.description: Verify the terminal PoW block via is_valid_terminal_pow_block: total difficulty >= TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY AND parent total difficulty < TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY

nodes.label: Validate Terminal Block Hash Override
nodes.description: When TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH is set, verify the execution payload parent hash matches exactly and epoch >= TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH_ACTIVATION_EPOCH

nodes.label: Merge Transition Validated
nodes.description: The terminal PoW block has been validated; the transition from PoW to PoS is confirmed

nodes.label: Post-Merge State (PoS Active)
nodes.description: The beacon chain now manages execution payloads; PoW is no longer the canonical execution mechanism

edges.label: First non-empty execution payload block arrives
Check if this is the transition block
Standard mode: validate terminal PoW conditions

sub_graphs.title: Bellatrix: Fork Choice and Execution Engine Coordination
sub_graphs.description: Models the interaction between the consensus layer fork choice and the execution engine via notify_forkchoice_updated

nodes.label: Fork Choice Head Computed
nodes.description: The fork choice algorithm has determined the current canonical head block

nodes.label: Compute Safe Execution Block Hash
nodes.description: Use get_safe_execution_block_hash to determine the latest execution block confirmed by justified checkpoint

nodes.label: Notify Fork Choice Updated
nodes.description: Call execution engine with head_block_hash, safe_block_hash, finalized_block_hash as an atomic operation

nodes.label: Execution Chain Reorganized
nodes.description: The execution engine has reorganized its chain to match the consensus head

nodes.label: Finalized Payloads Persisted
nodes.description: All execution payloads up to finalized_block_hash are irreversibly persisted

nodes.label: Initiate Payload Construction
nodes.description: If PayloadAttributes are provided, signal the execution engine to begin building a new execution payload

edges.label: Determine safe block for execution engine
All hashes ready, notify execution engine

sub_graphs.title: Bellatrix: Proposer Re-org Protection
sub_graphs.description: Models the should_override_forkchoice_update mechanism that protects against single-slot reorganizations

nodes.label: Fork Choice Update Pending
nodes.description: A fork choice update is about to be sent but may be suppressed for re-org protection

nodes.label: Check Head Block Timing
nodes.description: Determine if the head block arrived late (head_late condition)

nodes.label: Check Proposer Re-org Eligibility
nodes.description: Verify this node is the proposer for the next slot and a re-org is viable

nodes.label: Check FFG Competitiveness
nodes.description: Verify FFG voting is competitive (head not an FFG target that would be disrupted)

nodes.label: Check Finalization Health
nodes.description: Verify finalization is progressing normally

nodes.label: Check Weak Head / Strong Parent
nodes.description: Verify the head has weak support but its parent has strong support, confirming single-slot re-org safety

nodes.label: Fork Choice Update Suppressed
nodes.description: All re-org conditions met; fork choice update is suppressed to allow proposer to build on parent instead of head

nodes.label: Fork Choice Update Proceeds Normally
nodes.description: One or more re-org conditions not met; fork choice update proceeds as normal

edges.label: Not the proposer or re-org not viable

sub_graphs.title: Bellatrix: PoW Data Availability Error Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models how the system handles unavailability of PoW block data during merge transition validation

nodes.label: PoW Block Data Requested
nodes.description: The system has requested a PoW block via eth_getBlockByHash to validate the merge transition

nodes.label: Fetch PoW Block via JSON-RPC
nodes.description: Call eth_getBlockByHash to retrieve the terminal PoW block and its parent

nodes.label: PoW Block Data Available
nodes.description: The requested PoW block data has been successfully retrieved

nodes.label: PoW Block Data Unavailable
nodes.description: The PoW block data cannot be retrieved (e.g., execution client not synced)

nodes.label: Defer Block for Later Processing
nodes.description: Schedule the beacon block for reprocessing when PoW data becomes available

nodes.label: Proceed with Merge Validation
nodes.description: Continue with terminal PoW block validation using the retrieved data

external_entities.name: Execution Client JSON-RPC
external_entities.description: The execution layer client providing PoW block data via eth_getBlockByHash

ambiguities.text: The specification states 'Client software MUST NOT call this function until the transition conditions are met on the PoW network' but does not precisely define how the consensus client determines that PoW transition conditions are met.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the consensus client monitors TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY via the execution engine API and only proceeds when notified that the PoW chain has met the difficulty threshold.

ambiguities.text: The should_override_forkchoice_update function checks 8 conditions but the specification does not clarify behavior when conditions are partially met in rapid succession across slot boundaries.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all 8 conditions must evaluate to true simultaneously at a single point in time for the override to take effect. No partial or temporal aggregation is applied.

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions that 'assertions may fail due to unavailable data, requiring graceful degradation' but does not specify the maximum number of deferred blocks or timeout for reprocessing.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementation-defined limits on deferred block queues. Deferred blocks should be reprocessed when new execution layer data becomes available.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine connected via Engine API is trusted to correctly execute fork choice updates atomically and persist finalized data irreversibly.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A buggy or malicious execution engine could fail to reorganize correctly, persist incorrect state, or allow rollback of finalized payloads.

implicit_assumptions.description: The PoW chain data is available via eth_getBlockByHash during the merge transition period.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unavailable PoW data during the critical transition window could delay or prevent the merge, leaving the beacon chain unable to validate the terminal PoW block.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot manipulate the total difficulty of the PoW chain to trigger a premature or fraudulent merge transition.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A premature merge triggered by manipulated difficulty could cause the beacon chain to anchor to an attacker-controlled execution state.
